services.name: General Practice
services.description: Our general practitioners offer a wide range of primary healthcare services, including health assessments, preventive care, management of acute and chronic conditions, and referrals to specialists when needed.

services.name: Work Medical
services.description: We provide occupational health services tailored to the needs of businesses, including pre-employment medical assessments, workplace injury management, health promotion programs, and occupational health surveillance.

services.name: Mole View Skin Cancer Clinic
services.description: Our specialized skin cancer clinic offers early detection, diagnosis, and treatment of skin cancer, including skin examinations, mole mapping, biopsies, and personalized treatment plans.

services.name: Weight Loss Centre
services.description: Our weight loss centre offers personalized weight loss programs tailored to each individual’s needs, including customized meal plans, fitness training, behavioral counseling, and ongoing support to achieve long-term success.

services.name: Child Immunization
services.description: We offer comprehensive childhood immunization services to protect children from vaccine-preventable diseases, including routine vaccinations, catch-up vaccinations, and specialized vaccines as needed.

services.name: Telehealth
services.description: Our telehealth services allow patients to access medical care remotely via secure video consultations, providing convenient and timely healthcare from the comfort of home or office.

services.name: Chronic Disease Management
services.description: We specialize in managing chronic conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, heart disease, asthma, and arthritis, offering personalized care plans, regular monitoring, and support to improve health outcomes and quality of life.

services.name: Allied Health
services.description: Our allied health services complement medical care and include physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, mental health counseling, nutrition counseling, and social work services to support holistic health and well-being.
